# Why this notebook exists

The HT1080 and A549 cell lines were each sequenced once, but the FASTQ files
have been **re-quantified through two different upstream pipelines** at
different points in the project. Per-cell-line analyses (2.1.1 A549,
2.2.1 HT1080) all use the **NEW** counts; older reports (in
`data/RNAseq/AUG_13_2025_LOY_A549_HT1080/`) use the **OLD** counts. This
notebook asks: **how comparable are the two count tables, and would the
biological conclusions change if we'd kept the OLD counts?**

## Pipeline difference summary

| Field | OLD pipeline | NEW pipeline |
|---|---|---|
| Counts dir | `data/RNAseq/AUG_13_2025_LOY_A549_HT1080/counts/` | `projects/RNAseq/counts/AUG_2025_<cell>_LOY/` |
| Aligner | HISAT2 | STAR two-pass |
| Reference annotation | GENCODE v47 (`chr_patch_hapl_scaff`) | GENCODE v49 (primary assembly) |
| featureCounts | v2.0.1 | v2.1.1 |
| Sample composition | identical (9 HT1080 + 11 A549) | identical |

Same biological samples; same FASTQs; different aligner + reference + quantifier
version. Differences between the two count tables are therefore **technical** —
they tell us how much downstream interpretation is sensitive to the upstream
pipeline choice.

# 2. Load count tables

```{r load-counts}
load_featurecounts <- function(dir, cell_line, pipeline_label) {
  pat <- sprintf("^%s.*\\.txt$", cell_line)
  files <- list.files(dir, pattern = pat, full.names = TRUE)
  files <- files[!grepl("\\.summary$", files)]
  if (length(files) == 0) stop("No count files for ", cell_line, " in ", dir)

  dfs <- lapply(files, function(f) {
    # featureCounts header has a comment line + a column-name line; the count
    # column is the 7th (or last) column. Read with skip=1 (header line is
    # row 2 after the # comment).
    d <- fread(f, data.table = FALSE, skip = 1)
    sample_id <- sub("\\.txt$", "", basename(f))
    d <- d[, c(1, ncol(d))]
    names(d) <- c("geneID", sample_id)
    d
  })
  mat <- Reduce(function(a, b) merge(a, b, by = "geneID", all = TRUE), dfs)
  rownames(mat) <- mat$geneID
  mat$geneID <- NULL
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
  mat <- mat[grepl("^ENSG", rownames(mat)), , drop = FALSE]
  list(counts = mat, pipeline = pipeline_label, cell_line = cell_line)
}

ht_old <- load_featurecounts(OLD_COUNTS_DIR, "HT1080", "OLD")
ht_new <- load_featurecounts(file.path(NEW_COUNTS_DIR, "AUG_2025_HT1080_LOY"),
                             "HT1080", "NEW")
a549_old <- load_featurecounts(OLD_COUNTS_DIR, "A549", "OLD")
a549_new <- load_featurecounts(file.path(NEW_COUNTS_DIR, "AUG_2025_A549_LOY"),
                               "A549", "NEW")
```

# 3. Library sizes by pipeline

```{r library-sizes, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
build_libsize_df <- function(...) {
  bind_rows(lapply(list(...), function(obj) {
    data.frame(
      sample   = colnames(obj$counts),
      libsize  = colSums(obj$counts),
      cell     = obj$cell_line,
      pipeline = obj$pipeline,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}

libsize_df <- build_libsize_df(ht_old, ht_new, a549_old, a549_new) %>%
```

# 4. Gene-ID harmonization + filtering

The OLD pipeline annotated with GENCODE v47, NEW with v49. Both produce
Ensembl IDs like `ENSG00000123456.18` (with version suffix). The integer
ENSG accession is stable across versions; the suffix changes when the
gene's annotation is updated. We harmonize by stripping the suffix and
intersecting on the accession.

```{r harmonize}
strip_version <- function(ids) sub("\\.\\d+$", "", ids)

build_aligned <- function(old, new) {
  cm_old <- old$counts; rownames(cm_old) <- strip_version(rownames(cm_old))
  cm_new <- new$counts; rownames(cm_new) <- strip_version(rownames(cm_new))

  # If multiple rows collapse to the same stripped accession, sum.
  collapse <- function(m) {
    if (anyDuplicated(rownames(m))) {
      idx <- factor(rownames(m), levels = unique(rownames(m)))
      out <- rowsum(m, group = idx, reorder = FALSE)
      rownames(out) <- levels(idx)
      out
    } else m
  }
  cm_old <- collapse(cm_old)
  cm_new <- collapse(cm_new)

  shared <- intersect(rownames(cm_old), rownames(cm_new))
  list(
    counts_old = cm_old[shared, , drop = FALSE],
    counts_new = cm_new[shared, , drop = FALSE],
    n_old_unique  = length(setdiff(rownames(cm_old), rownames(cm_new))),
    n_new_unique  = length(setdiff(rownames(cm_new), rownames(cm_old))),
    n_shared = length(shared))
}

ht_aligned   <- build_aligned(ht_old, ht_new)
a549_aligned <- build_aligned(a549_old, a549_new)

cat("--- HT1080 ----------------------------------------\n")
cat(sprintf("  OLD-unique ENSG: %d\n", ht_aligned$n_old_unique))
cat(sprintf("  NEW-unique ENSG: %d\n", ht_aligned$n_new_unique))
cat(sprintf("  Shared ENSG:     %d\n", ht_aligned$n_shared))
cat("--- A549 ------------------------------------------\n")
cat(sprintf("  OLD-unique ENSG: %d\n", a549_aligned$n_old_unique))
cat(sprintf("  NEW-unique ENSG: %d\n", a549_aligned$n_new_unique))
cat(sprintf("  Shared ENSG:     %d\n", a549_aligned$n_shared))
```

## 4.1 Filter + TMM normalize each pipeline independently

```{r normalize}
normalize_counts <- function(cm) {
  dge <- DGEList(counts = cm)
  keep <- rowSums(cpm(dge) >= MIN_CPM) >= MIN_SAMPLES
  dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
  list(dge = dge,
       lcpm = cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2),
       kept = sum(keep))
}

ht_n_old <- normalize_counts(ht_aligned$counts_old)
ht_n_new <- normalize_counts(ht_aligned$counts_new)
a_n_old  <- normalize_counts(a549_aligned$counts_old)
a_n_new  <- normalize_counts(a549_aligned$counts_new)

cat(sprintf("HT1080 OLD kept after CPM filter: %d genes\n", ht_n_old$kept))
cat(sprintf("HT1080 NEW kept after CPM filter: %d genes\n", ht_n_new$kept))
cat(sprintf("A549   OLD kept after CPM filter: %d genes\n", a_n_old$kept))
cat(sprintf("A549   NEW kept after CPM filter: %d genes\n", a_n_new$kept))
```

# 5. Per-sample correlation: OLD vs NEW (same sample, two pipelines)

For each biological sample, compute Pearson correlation of logCPM between the
OLD and NEW pipelines on the intersection of kept genes.

```{r per-sample-correlation, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
per_sample_cor <- function(lcpm_old, lcpm_new, cell_label) {
  shared <- intersect(rownames(lcpm_old), rownames(lcpm_new))
  shared_samples <- intersect(colnames(lcpm_old), colnames(lcpm_new))
  if (length(shared_samples) == 0) stop("No shared sample names")

  bind_rows(lapply(shared_samples, function(s) {
    x <- lcpm_old[shared, s]
    y <- lcpm_new[shared, s]
    data.frame(
      sample = s, cell = cell_label,
      pearson_r  = cor(x, y, method = "pearson"),
      spearman_r = cor(x, y, method = "spearman"))
  }))
}

cor_ht <- per_sample_cor(ht_n_old$lcpm, ht_n_new$lcpm, "HT1080")
cor_a  <- per_sample_cor(a_n_old$lcpm,  a_n_new$lcpm,  "A549")
cor_df <- bind_rows(cor_ht, cor_a) %>%
  mutate(treatment = case_when(
    grepl("-LOY-", sample)      ~ "LOY",
    grepl("-CTRL-", sample)     ~ "CTRL",
    grepl("-PARENTAL-", sample) ~ "PARENTAL"))

fwrite(cor_df, file.path(TAB_DIR, "per_sample_correlation_OLD_vs_NEW.csv"))

p_cor <- ggplot(cor_df,
                aes(x = sample, y = pearson_r, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", pearson_r)),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 2.6, color = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CTRL" = "#009E73",
                               "LOY" = "#E69F00",
                               "PARENTAL" = "#999999")) +
  facet_wrap(~ cell, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.9, 1.0)) +
  labs(title = "Per-sample logCPM correlation: OLD vs NEW pipeline",
       y = "Pearson r (logCPM)", x = NULL, fill = NULL,
       subtitle = "Each bar is the same biological sample quantified two ways") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p_cor)
save_fig(p_cor, "per_sample_correlation_OLD_vs_NEW",
         width = 12, height = 5)

cor_df %>%
  group_by(cell) %>%
  summarize(
    median_pearson  = median(pearson_r),
    min_pearson     = min(pearson_r),
    median_spearman = median(spearman_r),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 4,
               caption = "Cross-pipeline correlation summary")
```

# 6. Per-gene mean expression scatter

For each cell line, mean logCPM per gene across all samples in OLD vs the
same gene's mean across all samples in NEW. Identity line for reference.

```{r per-gene-scatter, fig.height=6, fig.width=12}
per_gene_scatter <- function(lcpm_old, lcpm_new, cell_label) {
  shared <- intersect(rownames(lcpm_old), rownames(lcpm_new))
  d <- data.frame(
    gene = shared,
    mean_old = rowMeans(lcpm_old[shared, , drop = FALSE]),
    mean_new = rowMeans(lcpm_new[shared, , drop = FALSE])
  )
  d$diff <- d$mean_new - d$mean_old
  r <- cor(d$mean_old, d$mean_new)

  ggplot(d, aes(x = mean_old, y = mean_new)) +
    geom_hex(bins = 80) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "B", trans = "log10",
                         name = "n genes") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
                linetype = "dashed", color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    labs(title = sprintf("%s — per-gene mean logCPM, OLD vs NEW", cell_label),
         subtitle = sprintf("Pearson r = %.4f  ·  %d genes", r, nrow(d)),
         x = "Mean logCPM (OLD pipeline)",
         y = "Mean logCPM (NEW pipeline)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey30"))
}

p_g_ht <- per_gene_scatter(ht_n_old$lcpm, ht_n_new$lcpm, "HT1080")
p_g_a  <- per_gene_scatter(a_n_old$lcpm,  a_n_new$lcpm,  "A549")
p_g_combined <- p_g_ht | p_g_a
print(p_g_combined)
save_fig(p_g_combined, "per_gene_mean_scatter_OLD_vs_NEW",
         width = 14, height = 6)
```

# 7. Sample correlation heatmap (concatenated OLD + NEW)

Concatenate OLD and NEW logCPM matrices for each cell line and cluster all
samples together. Same biological sample under two pipelines should cluster
together — and if pipeline effects dominate biology, we'd see OLD vs NEW
samples cluster by pipeline instead.

```{r concat-heatmap-save}
# Build the correlation matrices and SAVE the heatmaps to PNG + PDF.
# Inline display is handled below via knitr::include_graphics() — more
# reliable than relying on pheatmap's grid behavior inside a knit chunk.
make_concat_heatmap <- function(lcpm_old, lcpm_new, cell_label) {
  shared <- intersect(rownames(lcpm_old), rownames(lcpm_new))
  colnames(lcpm_old) <- paste0(colnames(lcpm_old), "_OLD")
  colnames(lcpm_new) <- paste0(colnames(lcpm_new), "_NEW")
  M <- cbind(lcpm_old[shared, , drop = FALSE],
             lcpm_new[shared, , drop = FALSE])

  cor_mat <- cor(M)
  ann <- data.frame(
    pipeline  = sub(".*_(OLD|NEW)$", "\\1", colnames(M)),
    treatment = case_when(
      grepl("-LOY-", colnames(M))      ~ "LOY",
      grepl("-CTRL-", colnames(M))     ~ "CTRL",
      grepl("-PARENTAL-", colnames(M)) ~ "PARENTAL"),
    row.names = colnames(M)
  )
  ann_colors <- list(
    pipeline  = c(OLD = "#984EA3", NEW = "#FF7F00"),
    treatment = c(CTRL = "#009E73", LOY = "#E69F00", PARENTAL = "#999999"))

  common_args <- list(
    cor_mat,
    annotation_col = ann, annotation_row = ann,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    color = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(100),
    breaks = seq(0.85, 1.0, length.out = 100),
    main = sprintf("%s — Pearson r heatmap (OLD + NEW concatenated)",
                   cell_label),
    fontsize = 7, fontsize_row = 6, fontsize_col = 6,
    width = 9, height = 7)

  do.call(pheatmap, c(common_args,
    list(filename = file.path(FIG_DIR,
           paste0("sample_cor_heatmap_", cell_label, ".png")))))
  do.call(pheatmap, c(common_args,
    list(filename = file.path(FIG_DIR,
           paste0("sample_cor_heatmap_", cell_label, ".pdf")))))
  cat(sprintf("Saved: sample_cor_heatmap_%s.(png|pdf)\n", cell_label))
}

make_concat_heatmap(ht_n_old$lcpm, ht_n_new$lcpm, "HT1080")
make_concat_heatmap(a_n_old$lcpm,  a_n_new$lcpm,  "A549")
```

# 8. Differential expression on OLD vs NEW: do the conclusions change?

Three contrasts run on each pipeline's counts:

1. **Paired** LOY vs sgCTRL (`~ 0 + treatment + passage`) — canonical
2. **Unpaired** LOY vs sgCTRL (`~ 0 + treatment`) — passage drift not modeled
3. **Pooled** LOY vs (PARENTAL + sgCTRL) — combined Y+ baseline, n=6 vs n=3 (HT1080) or n=7 vs n=4 (A549)

Identical underlying biology under both pipelines → high logFC correlation and
substantial DEG overlap regardless of which contrast we pick.

```{r de-helpers}
# HGNC symbol map keyed by Ensembl gene accession (stripped of version)
gene_anno <- ensembldb::genes(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, gene_name) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_name), nzchar(gene_name)) %>%
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
ens_to_sym <- setNames(gene_anno$gene_name, gene_anno$gene_id)

build_meta <- function(sample_ids) {
  data.frame(
    sample_id = sample_ids,
    treatment = case_when(
      grepl("-LOY-", sample_ids)      ~ "LOY",
      grepl("-CTRL-", sample_ids)     ~ "CTRL",
      grepl("-PARENTAL-", sample_ids) ~ "PARENTAL"),
    replicate = sub(".*-(\\d+)$", "\\1", sample_ids),
    row.names = sample_ids,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# Run any of the three contrast types on a DGEList.
run_de <- function(dge, meta, design_type = c("paired", "unpaired", "pooled")) {
  design_type <- match.arg(design_type)
  m <- meta[colnames(dge), , drop = FALSE]

  if (design_type %in% c("paired", "unpaired")) {
    keep <- m$treatment %in% c("CTRL", "LOY")
    dge <- dge[, keep, keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]; m <- m[keep, ]
    m$treatment <- factor(m$treatment, levels = c("CTRL", "LOY"))
    m$passage   <- factor(m$replicate)
    dge <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
    if (design_type == "paired") {
      # Drop passages represented in only one treatment to avoid rank
      # deficiency (e.g., A549 PARENTAL absent — only here for symmetry —
      # but also covers any other unbalanced edge case).
      pt <- table(m$passage, m$treatment)
      shared <- rownames(pt)[rowSums(pt > 0) == ncol(pt)]
      keep_p <- m$passage %in% shared
      dge <- dge[, keep_p, keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]; m <- m[keep_p, ]
      m$passage <- droplevels(m$passage)
      des <- model.matrix(~ 0 + treatment + passage, data = m)
    } else {
      des <- model.matrix(~ 0 + treatment, data = m)
    }
    colnames(des) <- gsub("^treatment", "", colnames(des))
    cm <- makeContrasts(contrasts = "LOY - CTRL", levels = colnames(des))
  } else {
    # pooled: LOY vs Y+ (PARENTAL + CTRL); unpaired by construction.
    m$y_pool <- factor(
      ifelse(m$treatment == "LOY", "Y_NEG", "Y_POS"),
      levels = c("Y_POS", "Y_NEG"))
    dge <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
    des <- model.matrix(~ 0 + y_pool, data = m)
    colnames(des) <- gsub("^y_pool", "", colnames(des))
    cm <- makeContrasts(contrasts = "Y_NEG - Y_POS", levels = colnames(des))
  }

  v   <- voom(dge, des, plot = FALSE)
  fit <- lmFit(v, des) %>% contrasts.fit(cm) %>% eBayes()
  topTable(fit, coef = 1, n = Inf, sort.by = "P") %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    dplyr::rename(PValue = P.Value, FDR = adj.P.Val) %>%
    mutate(symbol = unname(ens_to_sym[gene]),
           symbol = ifelse(is.na(symbol) | symbol == "", gene, symbol))
}

# Compare two DE tables, returning shared logFC + significance flags.
compare_de <- function(de_old, de_new, cell_label, contrast_label) {
  shared <- inner_join(
    de_old %>% dplyr::select(gene, symbol, logFC_old = logFC,
                             FDR_old = FDR, P_old = PValue),
    de_new %>% dplyr::select(gene,         logFC_new = logFC,
                             FDR_new = FDR, P_new = PValue),
    by = "gene")
  sig_old <- de_old %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < ALPHA, abs(logFC) > LFC_THR) %>%
    pull(gene) %>% unique()
  sig_new <- de_new %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < ALPHA, abs(logFC) > LFC_THR) %>%
    pull(gene) %>% unique()
  list(cell      = cell_label,
       contrast  = contrast_label,
       n_old     = length(sig_old),
       n_new     = length(sig_new),
       intersect = length(intersect(sig_old, sig_new)),
       jaccard   = length(intersect(sig_old, sig_new)) /
                   max(length(union(sig_old, sig_new)), 1),
       lfc_pearson_r = cor(shared$logFC_old, shared$logFC_new,
                           use = "complete.obs"),
       shared_df = shared)
}

# Concordance scatter with ggrepel labels on the top DEGs (significant in
# BOTH pipelines, ranked by combined -log10(FDR)).
plot_lfc_concord <- function(cmp, cell_label, contrast_label, n_label = 15) {
  d <- cmp$shared_df %>%
    mutate(both_sig = FDR_old < ALPHA & FDR_new < ALPHA &
                      abs(logFC_old) > LFC_THR & abs(logFC_new) > LFC_THR,
           rank_score = -log10(pmax(FDR_old, 1e-300)) +
                        -log10(pmax(FDR_new, 1e-300)))
  top_lab <- d %>% dplyr::filter(both_sig) %>%
    slice_max(rank_score, n = n_label)
  ggplot(d, aes(x = logFC_old, y = logFC_new)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.5, color = "grey60") +
    geom_point(data = d %>% dplyr::filter(both_sig),
               alpha = 0.85, size = 1.2, color = "#D55E00") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
                color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey60") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey60") +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = top_lab, aes(label = symbol),
      size = 2.7, fontface = "italic", color = "grey15",
      max.overlaps = Inf, segment.color = "grey50",
      segment.size = 0.25, box.padding = 0.4, min.segment.length = 0.1,
      force = 2) +
    labs(title = sprintf("%s — %s, OLD vs NEW logFC",
                         cell_label, contrast_label),
         subtitle = sprintf("Pearson r = %.3f · orange = sig in BOTH pipelines · top %d labeled",
                            cmp$lfc_pearson_r, nrow(top_lab)),
         x = expression(log[2]~"FC (OLD pipeline)"),
         y = expression(log[2]~"FC (NEW pipeline)")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey30"))
}
```

```{r de-run-all}
meta_ht <- build_meta(colnames(ht_n_old$lcpm))
meta_a  <- build_meta(colnames(a_n_old$lcpm))

all_de <- list(
  HT1080_OLD_paired   = run_de(ht_n_old$dge, meta_ht, "paired"),
  HT1080_NEW_paired   = run_de(ht_n_new$dge, meta_ht, "paired"),
  HT1080_OLD_unpaired = run_de(ht_n_old$dge, meta_ht, "unpaired"),
  HT1080_NEW_unpaired = run_de(ht_n_new$dge, meta_ht, "unpaired"),
  HT1080_OLD_pooled   = run_de(ht_n_old$dge, meta_ht, "pooled"),
  HT1080_NEW_pooled   = run_de(ht_n_new$dge, meta_ht, "pooled"),
  A549_OLD_paired     = run_de(a_n_old$dge,  meta_a,  "paired"),
  A549_NEW_paired     = run_de(a_n_new$dge,  meta_a,  "paired"),
  A549_OLD_unpaired   = run_de(a_n_old$dge,  meta_a,  "unpaired"),
  A549_NEW_unpaired   = run_de(a_n_new$dge,  meta_a,  "unpaired"),
  A549_OLD_pooled     = run_de(a_n_old$dge,  meta_a,  "pooled"),
  A549_NEW_pooled     = run_de(a_n_new$dge,  meta_a,  "pooled"))

# Save all 12 DE tables
for (nm in names(all_de)) {
  fwrite(all_de[[nm]],
         file.path(TAB_DIR, sprintf("DE_%s.csv", nm)))
}

cmp_list <- list(
  HT1080_paired   = compare_de(all_de$HT1080_OLD_paired,
                               all_de$HT1080_NEW_paired,
                               "HT1080", "LOY vs sgCTRL (paired)"),
  HT1080_unpaired = compare_de(all_de$HT1080_OLD_unpaired,
                               all_de$HT1080_NEW_unpaired,
                               "HT1080", "LOY vs sgCTRL (unpaired)"),
  HT1080_pooled   = compare_de(all_de$HT1080_OLD_pooled,
                               all_de$HT1080_NEW_pooled,
                               "HT1080", "LOY vs pooled Y+"),
  A549_paired     = compare_de(all_de$A549_OLD_paired,
                               all_de$A549_NEW_paired,
                               "A549",   "LOY vs sgCTRL (paired)"),
  A549_unpaired   = compare_de(all_de$A549_OLD_unpaired,
                               all_de$A549_NEW_unpaired,
                               "A549",   "LOY vs sgCTRL (unpaired)"),
  A549_pooled     = compare_de(all_de$A549_OLD_pooled,
                               all_de$A549_NEW_pooled,
                               "A549",   "LOY vs pooled Y+"))

summary_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(cmp_list, function(x) {
  data.frame(cell = x$cell, contrast = x$contrast,
             sig_OLD = x$n_old, sig_NEW = x$n_new,
             intersect = x$intersect, jaccard = x$jaccard,
             lfc_r = x$lfc_pearson_r) }))

fwrite(summary_tbl, file.path(TAB_DIR, "DE_OLD_vs_NEW_summary.csv"))
knitr::kable(summary_tbl, digits = 4,
             caption = "DE concordance: OLD vs NEW pipeline across three contrast types")
```

# 9. Verdict

```{r verdict}
verdict_line <- function(cmp) {
  if (cmp$lfc_pearson_r > 0.9 && cmp$jaccard > 0.5) {
    "CONCORDANT"
  } else if (cmp$lfc_pearson_r > 0.8) {
    "MOSTLY CONCORDANT"
  } else {
    "DIVERGENT"
  }
}

for (nm in names(cmp_list)) {
  x <- cmp_list[[nm]]
  cat(sprintf("%-32s %s\n", paste0(x$cell, " · ", x$contrast),
              verdict_line(x)))
  cat(sprintf("  OLD DEGs %d | NEW DEGs %d | intersect %d (Jaccard %.2f) | logFC r = %.3f\n\n",
              x$n_old, x$n_new, x$intersect, x$jaccard,
              x$lfc_pearson_r))
}
```
